lesson.title: 三角比

en.title: Trigonometric Ratios
en.description: Relate trigonometric ratios to unit-circle coordinates; determine exact and approximate ratios; identify every angle in a stated domain; solve geometric applications.

lesson.description: 把三角比与单位圆坐标联系；求精确值和近似值；找出指定区间内全部角；解决几何应用。

concepts.title: 单位圆坐标与符号
concepts.summary: 单位圆上的 $P(\theta)=(x,y)$ 满足 $\cos\theta=x$、$\sin\theta=y$，且 $x\ne0$ 时 $\tan\theta=y/x$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先用 $x^2+y^2=1$ 和象限确定坐标符号，再代入定义。

pitfalls: 正弦、余弦均在 −1 与 1 之间；y 轴上的正切无定义。

en.title: Unit-circle coordinates and signs
en.summary: For $P(\theta)=(x,y)$ on the unit circle, $\cos\theta=x$, $\sin\theta=y$, and $\tan\theta=y/x$ when $x\ne0$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use $x^2+y^2=1$, identify the quadrant, and then apply the coordinate definitions.

pitfalls: Sine and cosine lie between −1 and 1. Tangent is undefined on the y-axis.

concepts.title: 余割、正割与余切

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先求基本比值，再在分母不为零时取倒数，并化简或有理化。

pitfalls: 在 y 轴上直接用余切 x/y；此时余切为 0，而正切无定义。

en.title: Cosecant, secant, and cotangent

method.title: Method
method.body: Compute the primary ratio first, take its reciprocal when defined, and simplify or rationalize.

pitfalls: Use cotangent = x/y directly on the y-axis; it is 0 there although tangent is undefined.

concepts.title: 特殊角精确值
concepts.summary: 用 $30^\circ$–$60^\circ$–$90^\circ$ 与 $45^\circ$–$45^\circ$–$90^\circ$ 三角形，结合参照角和象限符号。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先去整圈，确定终边，再代入精确坐标。

pitfalls: 要求精确值时保留根式或分数，不用近似小数代替。

en.title: Exact special-angle values
en.summary: Use $30^\circ$–$60^\circ$–$90^\circ$ and $45^\circ$–$45^\circ$–$90^\circ$ triangles; apply reference angles and quadrant signs.

method.title: Method
method.body: Reduce by full rotations, locate the terminal arm, and substitute exact coordinates.

pitfalls: Do not replace a requested exact radical or fraction with a rounded decimal.

concepts.title: 计算器近似值与反函数
concepts.summary: 计算器角度/弧度模式必须与题目一致。$\sin^{-1}a$ 是反函数，不是 $1/\sin a$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 保留中间精度，倒数比值加括号，最后按要求四舍五入。

pitfalls: 反函数键只返回主值；仍需检查象限符号与无定义情形。

en.title: Calculator values and inverse functions
en.summary: Match degree or radian mode to the given angle. $\sin^{-1}a$ denotes an inverse function, not $1/\sin a$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Keep unrounded intermediate results, evaluate reciprocal ratios using parentheses, and round only at the end.

pitfalls: An inverse key returns a principal angle only. Check quadrant signs and undefined values separately.

concepts.title: 指定区间内的全部角
concepts.summary: 结合参照角、全部适用象限及同终边角，再与指定区间取交集。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 正弦/余弦每 $2\pi$（或 $360^\circ$）重复，正切/余切每 $\pi$（或 $180^\circ$）重复；逐一检查端点。

pitfalls: 注意严格或包含端点，并使用题给区间的角度单位。

en.title: All angles in a specified domain
en.summary: Use a reference angle, all suitable quadrants, and coterminal angles, then intersect with the stated domain.

method.title: Method
method.body: Generate sine/cosine solutions every $2\pi$ (or $360^\circ$), tangent/cotangent every $\pi$ (or $180^\circ$); test each endpoint.

pitfalls: Keep strict and inclusive endpoints; give answers in the units of the domain.

concepts.title: 任意终边点的三角比

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先求正半径，以带符号坐标求比值，再求有定义的倒数。

pitfalls: 单个比值配上较宽角度区间时，其他比值可能有多组符号。

en.title: Ratios from an arbitrary terminal point

method.title: Method
method.body: Compute the positive radius, use signed coordinates in the ratios, and obtain reciprocals where defined.

pitfalls: A ratio plus a broad angle domain may allow more than one sign choice.

concepts.title: 几何、斜率与应用
concepts.summary: 三角比连接圆弧、切线段、直线斜率及机械运动；保留全部几何假设。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 画带标签图，建立直角三角形或坐标关系，并检查条件能否确定唯一结果。

pitfalls: 示意图不能代替长度条件；未给出的长度应保留为参数。

en.title: Geometry, slopes, and applications
en.summary: Trigonometry connects circle arcs, tangent segments, line slopes, and mechanical motion; preserve all geometric assumptions.

method.title: Method
method.body: Build a labelled diagram, derive the right-triangle or coordinate relationship, and check whether the data determine a unique result.

pitfalls: A drawing is not a scale specification; an absent length must remain a parameter.

questions.prompt: 余弦和正弦的最大、最小值是什么？用文字及不等式表示，并用计算器确认。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: 两个坐标均在 −1 与 1 之间，所以最小值 −1、最大值 1：$-1\le\cos\theta\le1$，$-1\le\sin\theta\le1$。角度模式验证 $\cos0^\circ=1$、$\cos180^\circ=-1$、$\sin90^\circ=1$、$\sin270^\circ=-1$。

en.prompt: What are the maximum and minimum values of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$? State them in words and as inequalities; confirm with a calculator.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: Both coordinates range from −1 to 1, so the minimum is −1 and maximum is 1: $-1\le\cos\theta\le1$, $-1\le\sin\theta\le1$. In degree mode, $\cos0^\circ=1$, $\cos180^\circ=-1$, $\sin90^\circ=1$, $\sin270^\circ=-1$.

questions.prompt: 用第一象限单位圆解释：正角增至 $90^\circ$ 时，正切怎样从 0 变成无定义？计算器此时怎样显示？

en.prompt: Explain how $\tan\theta$ changes from 0 to undefined as positive $\theta\le90^\circ$ increases in quadrant I. What happens on a calculator when it is undefined?

questions.prompt: 联系知识——边注提问。 (a) 坐标比怎样与直角三角形的余弦、正弦定义相连？  (b) 解释 $\tan\theta=y/x$ 怎样与直角三角形正切定义一致。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (a) 第一象限参照三角形中，邻边 $x$、对边 $y$、斜边 1，故余弦 $x/1=x$、正弦 $y/1=y$。带符号坐标把定义推广到所有象限。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (b) 正切是对边除以邻边；这里对边 y、邻边 x，所以当 $x\ne0$ 时为 $y/x$。

questions.answer: (a) $\cos\theta=x$, $\sin\theta=y$; (b) $\tan\theta=y/x$, $x\ne0$

en.prompt: Link the Ideas — marginal questions. (a) How do the coordinate ratios connect to the right-triangle definitions of cosine and sine?  (b) Explain how $\tan\theta=y/x$ is consistent with the right-triangle tangent definition.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (a) In the first-quadrant reference triangle, adjacent $=x$, opposite $=y$, and hypotenuse $=1$. Thus cosine $=x/1=x$ and sine $=y/1=y$. Signed coordinates extend the definitions to all quadrants.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (b) Tangent is opposite/adjacent. Here opposite is y and adjacent is x, so it equals $y/x$ for $x\ne0$.

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (a) 在第三象限标出 $A$，画射线 $OA$ 和单位圆。两坐标均为负，$OA=\sqrt{9/25+16/25}=1$。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: 取倒数：$\csc\theta=-5/4$，$\sec\theta=-5/3$，$\cot\theta=3/4$；符号符合第三象限。

en.prompt: The point $A(-3/5,-4/5)$ lies at the intersection of the unit circle and the terminal arm of $\theta$ in standard position. (a) Draw a model. (b) Determine all six trigonometric ratios in lowest terms.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (a) Plot $A$ in quadrant III; draw the ray $OA$ and a unit circle. Both coordinates are negative, while $OA=\sqrt{9/25+16/25}=1$.

steps.title: Calculate

en.prompt: Example 1 — marginal questions. (a) The y-coordinate of $P(\theta)$ is defined as $\sin\theta$. Why is this true?  (b) Explain the arithmetic used to simplify the double fraction for tangent.  (c) Why does a positive tangent make sense?  (d) Explain how the cosecant answer was determined.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (a) The radius is 1, so the signed opposite/radius ratio is $y/1=y$. At A it is $-4/5$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (b) $(-4/5)/(-3/5)=(-4/5)(-5/3)=4/3$. Dividing by a nonzero fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (c) A is in III, where both x and y are negative. Their quotient $y/x$ is positive.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (d) $\csc\theta=1/\sin\theta=1/(-4/5)=-5/4$, by inverting the nonzero sine ratio.

en.answer: (a) $\sin\theta=y=-4/5$; (b) $4/3$; (c) Both coordinates are negative, so their quotient is positive.; (d) $-5/4$

questions.prompt: 点 $B(-1/3,2\sqrt2/3)$ 在单位圆及标准位置角 $\theta$ 的终边上。(a) 画图。(b) 求六个三角比的最简值。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (b) 读出 $\sin\theta=2\sqrt2/3$，$\cos\theta=-1/3$；相除得 $\tan\theta=-2\sqrt2$。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: $\csc\theta=3/(2\sqrt2)=3\sqrt2/4$，$\sec\theta=-3$，$\cot\theta=-1/(2\sqrt2)=-\sqrt2/4$。

questions.answer: $(\sin,\cos,\tan,\csc,\sec,\cot)=(2\sqrt2/3,-1/3,-2\sqrt2,3\sqrt2/4,-3,-\sqrt2/4)$.

en.prompt: The point $B(-1/3,2\sqrt2/3)$ lies on the unit circle and terminal arm of $\theta$ in standard position. (a) Draw a model. (b) Determine all six ratios in lowest terms.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (a) $x<0,y>0$, so plot $B$ in quadrant II and join $O$ to $B$. Check $(-1/3)^2+(2\sqrt2/3)^2=1/9+8/9=1$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (b) Read $\sin\theta=2\sqrt2/3$, $\cos\theta=-1/3$; divide to get $\tan\theta=-2\sqrt2$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: $\csc\theta=3/(2\sqrt2)=3\sqrt2/4$, $\sec\theta=-3$, $\cot\theta=-1/(2\sqrt2)=-\sqrt2/4$.

exercises.prompt: 仿照《镜中奇遇记》，设想单位圆的正旋转改为顺时针，但坐标系保持通常方向。 (a) 从 $(0,1)$ 起顺时针量正角，画单位圆并标出 $R(\pi/6)$、$R(5\pi/6)$、$R(7\pi/6)$、$R(11\pi/6)$。  (b) 给出新 $R(\pi/6)$ 与 $R(5\pi/6)$ 的坐标。  (c) 新角与通常标准位置角的关系是什么？  (d) 新量角法与航海方位角怎样对应？解释。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (a) 新角 $\alpha$ 对应通常角 $\theta=\pi/2-\alpha$，故 $R(\alpha)=(\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha)$。四点依次位于第一、四、三、二象限：$(1/2,\sqrt3/2)$、$(1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$、$(-1/2,-\sqrt3/2)$、$(-1/2,\sqrt3/2)$。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (c) 新零点比通常零点高四分之一圈，正方向相反。因此 $\theta=\pi/2-\alpha$（模 $2\pi$），或 $\theta=90^\circ-\alpha$（模 $360^\circ$）。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (d) 若 +y 为北、+x 为东，新法从北顺时针量角，与全圆方位角的方向约定一致。乘 $180/\pi$ 转成角度，再归入 $[0^\circ,360^\circ)$；四个方位角为 $30^\circ,150^\circ,210^\circ,330^\circ$。

en.prompt: Paula observes sine rising from 0 to 1 in quadrant I. (a) She concludes sine is increasing in quadrant I. Use specific values to show whether she is correct.  (b) Is sine increasing in quadrant II? Explain.  (c) Does sine increase in another quadrant? If so, which? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (a) She is correct: for $0^\circ,30^\circ,45^\circ,60^\circ,90^\circ$, the sine values are $0,1/2,\sqrt2/2,\sqrt3/2,1$, in increasing order. The unit-circle y-coordinate rises continuously along this arc.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (b) No. From $90^\circ$ to $180^\circ$, y decreases from 1 to 0; e.g. $\sin120^\circ=\sqrt3/2>\sin150^\circ=1/2$.

en.answer: (a) Yes; sine increases in I.; (b) No; it decreases in II.; (c) Sine also increases in IV.

exercises.prompt: $P$ 为单位圆与标准位置角 $\theta$ 终边的交点。 (a) 用三角比写 $OP$ 的斜率公式。  (b) 公式适用于每个象限吗？解释。  (c) 用三角比斜率写任意直线 OP 的方程。  (d) 用变换说明该方程可推广至任意斜率有定义的直线。

steps.title: 计算
steps.body: (a) $P=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$，故 $m=(\sin\theta-0)/(\cos\theta-0)=\tan\theta$，条件为 $\cos\theta\ne0$。

steps.title: 计算

en.prompt: $P$ is the intersection of the unit circle and the terminal arm of an angle $\theta$ in standard position. (a) Give a formula for the slope of $OP$ in terms of trigonometric ratios. steps.body: (a) $P=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$, so $m=(\sin\theta-0)/(\cos\theta-0)=\tan\theta$, provided $\cos\theta\ne0$.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (b) Yes, in all four quadrants, because the signed-coordinate slope formula still holds. On the y-axis ($\theta=\pi/2+k\pi$) both the slope and tangent are undefined; this is an axis exception, not a quadrant exception.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (c) Every nonvertical OP passes through the origin, so $y=(\tan\theta)x$. If OP is vertical, use $x=0$ instead.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.body: (d) Translate the origin-line by $(h,k)$: $y-k=(\tan\theta)(x-h)$. For any finite slope $m$, choose $\theta=\tan^{-1}m$; translating vertically by $b$ gives $y=mx+b$. Thus every nonvertical line is obtained.

en.answer: (a) $m=\tan\theta$ when $\cos\theta\ne0$; (b) All four quadrants; vertical lines have undefined slope.; (c) $y=(\tan\theta)x$; vertical case $x=0$; (d) $y-k=(\tan\theta)(x-h)$, equivalently $y=mx+b$
